spots.name: Knockadoon
spots.notes: Strong shore options around the point; best with moderate sea movement and safe footing.

spots.name: Mine Head
spots.notes: Highly exposed mark; only fish in settled weather with careful access planning.

spots.name: Cork Harbour to Ballycotton (Ram Point sector)
spots.notes: Covers mixed marks from inner harbour out toward Ballycotton; fish species shift with tide and exposure.

spots.name: Galley Head to Ballymacus Point
spots.type: Open Atlantic rock and surf marks
spots.notes: Atlantic-facing coastline with productive rough ground; monitor swell and wind direction closely.
